Each of those six was retried once after other work, and all six then returned content. No retries were made beyond that. Searches used: 0. Judgment calls for the orchestrator: One Little Earth (batch name Philadelphia Environmental Film Festival; thin public role); Shakespeare in Clark Park (only attending; reclassify if ticketed); Project Capoeira (status rests on an undated weekly timetable, newest dated item September 2024); Philadelphia Regional Arts Consortium hidden as out_of_scope (services body for arts organizations). Personal-looking emails on group sites were not recorded. Website changed for Philadelphia Sinfonia (.com to .org).
